The file imports the other persistence adapters the same way (SessionRepository, BookingRepository, PuckPayClient, DropTextClient on lines 1-2 and 4-5). The rule checks static import edges, not whether the code only does construction, so wiring at startup counts as a layer skip just like a data-access call would.
